sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT id, text, kind, article FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull'
SELECT id, title, status, published_at FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23'
SELECT id, text, kind, article, created_at FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT article.status AS st, count() FROM passage GROUP BY st
SELECT parent.status AS st, count() FROM passage GROUP BY st
SELECT out.status AS st, count() FROM covers GROUP BY st
SELECT in.status AS st, count() FROM covers GROUP BY st
SELECT article.status AS st, count() FROM factbox GROUP BY st
SELECT id, title, status, desk, published_at FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'] ORDER BY published_at
